text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm Nakayama Festa. Just so you know,
I've got no use for races that don't make my skin crawl.
What I want is a thrill.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If you chicken out and start spouting half-assed excuses,
you and I are through.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Now, let's start a match that'll get our blood pumping.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
